_context: Regression cascade risk assessment. The CSV maps introducing bugs (BUG_IDS, space-separated integers) to the fixes they necessitated (FIX_ID). Model as a directed dependency graph (each introducing bug -> the fix it triggered) and assess systemic failure propagation risk. forward_reach of a node = count of distinct nodes reachable from it via directed edges, exclusive of itself. Exclude keys prefixed with _ from output.

graph_topology.largest_scc_size: int: 0 if none; ties by smallest minimum-member ID

cascade_analysis.total_cascade_impact: int: sum of forward_reach across all nodes
cascade_analysis.top_10_cascade_sources: [{bug_id, forward_reach}]; ranked by forward_reach DESC, bug_id ASC

greedy_prevention._objective: Determine a triage sequence that halves total cascade impact. Each step: remove the remaining node with greatest forward_reach (ties: smallest ID), recomputing after each removal. Stop when cumulative removed reach >= 50% of original total_cascade_impact or zero remaining reach.

component_risk._note: Map nodes to components via patch_metadata.jsonl (bug_id field); unmapped nodes = 'unknown'. Use pre-removal forward_reach.
component_risk.top_5_components: [{component, total_forward_reach, bug_count}]; ranked by total_forward_reach DESC, component ASC
